functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.relic_bonus(p_effect text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select r.effect_value from app_private.player_relic_loadouts l join public.fishing_relics r on r.id=l.relic_id
 where l.user_id=(select auth.uid()) and r.enabled and r.effect_kind=p_effect),0)
$function$

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((effect_kind = 'none'::text) AND (effect_value = (0)::numeric)) OR ((effect_kind = ANY (ARRAY['fuel_active_slots'::text, 'bait_active_slots'::text])) AND (((rarity = 'epic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (1)::numeric)) OR ((rarity = 'mythic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (2)::numeric)))) OR ((effect_kind = 'personal_bait_hours'::text) AND (((rarity = 'rare'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (2)::numeric)) OR ((rarity = 'epic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (4)::numeric)) OR ((rarity = 'mythic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (8)::numeric)))) OR ((effect_kind = 'fishing_wait_seconds'::text) AND (((rarity = 'rare'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = 0.5)) OR ((rarity = 'epic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (1)::numeric)) OR ((rarity = 'mythic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (2)::numeric)))) OR ((effect_kind = 'trap_seconds_per_bait'::text) AND (((rarity = 'rare'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (30)::numeric)) OR ((rarity = 'epic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (90)::numeric)) OR ((rarity = 'mythic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (180)::numeric)))) OR ((effect_kind = 'boat_discount_gold'::text) AND (((rarity = 'rare'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (50)::numeric)) OR ((rarity = 'epic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (150)::numeric)) OR ((rarity = 'mythic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (400)::numeric)))) OR ((effect_kind = 'bait_discount_gold'::text) AND (((rarity = 'epic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (1)::numeric)) OR ((rarity = 'mythic'::game_rarity) AND (effect_value = (2)::numeric))))))
